Prompts

```
['run the GPT-2 model training loop with distributed data parallel across multiple GPUs', 'create a Muon optimizer with SGD-momentum and Newton-Schulz orthogonalization for 2D parameters', 'build a CausalSelfAttention layer with rotary embeddings, QK norm, and value mixing via lamb parameter', 'review the DistributedDataLoader class that loads tokenized data shards across distributed processes', 'test the zeropower_via_newtonschulz5 function that computes matrix orthogonalization using quintic Newton-Schulz iteration']
```
